evidence_quotes.section1_quid_pro_quo: Rep jumps directly into availability checking ('Not today. We are full. Yup, I have tomorrow.') with no framing of time, value of quote, or explicit ask for agreement before proceeding.
evidence_quotes.section2_their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves immediately into logistics probing without 'What are your biggest concerns?' or equivalent.
evidence_quotes.section4_estimate_anchor: Rep provides hourly rate ($300/hr for 3 movers, $200/hr for 2 movers) and mentions 2.5-hour minimum, but does not anchor to a typical range for this job size or personalize based on customer's stated concerns (rain, water in lot, special packing for art). Final total ($900–$1050) emerges through back-and-forth calculation, not delivered as a framed estimate.
evidence_quotes.section4_pricing_framing: Trip fee ($150) disclosed mid-conversation ('it's just outside of our radius'), and 2.5-hour minimum mentioned, but no upfront framing of all fees or the 'not a guess' / 15-minute-increment commitment language.
evidence_quotes.section4_feels_fair_silence: Never asked. Rep moves to availability alternatives ('Do you want Sunday?') without checking if the customer finds the pricing acceptable.
evidence_quotes.section5_two_promises: On-Time Guarantee not mentioned. Damage Coverage not mentioned. Neither promise is covered.
evidence_quotes.section5_closes_loop: False. No 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent closing question.
evidence_quotes.section6_final_concerns: Asked as 'Awesome. Do you have any other questions for me?' — a throwaway / empty-out phrasing that invites an automatic no.
evidence_quotes.section6_catch_all: Not asked. No 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' equivalent.
evidence_quotes.section7_explicit_ask: Never asked directly. Rep confirms the booking ('Okay, sounds good. I am on board for that') and walks through payment method, but never explicitly says 'Would you like our help with your move?' or equivalent plain ask for the business.
evidence_quotes.section7_rate_lock: Mentioned: 'No deposit required to get on our schedule and there's no charges to change the date if something comes up and then no fees to cancel.'
evidence_quotes.section7_booking_confirmed: Partial. Date confirmed (Saturday 8:39 AM arrival at storage unit); phone collected; one address confirmed (300 Pepper Mill Loop); second address confirmed (7320 W State Hwy 29); no crew-size or truck-size re-confirmed at close; no notes left for crew about rain/water hazard concern; payment method discussed (card/debit/ApplePay) but booking details not fully recapped.

top_strength: Brianne gathered detailed logistics across multiple stops, addresses, and special items (rain mitigation, artwork packing, garage stacking) and calmly managed a technically complex job with two drop-offs and weather contingency.
coaching_note: Open every call with the quid pro quo framing ('10–15 minutes, you can walk away with a quote you can depend on, does that sound good?') and always ask 'What are your biggest concerns about this move?' before diving into logistics — this call jumped straight to probing, skipped the Two Promises entirely, and never explicitly asked for the business.
